facts.fact: Matty 付披萨钱、盯着她吃够；JJ 皱眉。
facts.anchor: It was Matty who paid for the pizzas. Matty who made sure Emily ate enough. She discovered her appetite and grabbed several slices of margherita, one after another, while JJ watched with a knitted brow, looking far from celebratory.

Waiting until she knew they were watching, she made a show of taking a large swig of tequila from the bottle that had magically appeared in the room. Swallowed it, winced, then threw herself across the sofa, lolling her head back over the armrest and closing her eyes.

facts.fact: 临街房间听得见所有进出。
facts.anchor: she heard Alice and Gareth leave. That was the thing about having the bedroom nearest the street.

facts.fact: 小时候每次开门声她都等母亲的脚步。
facts.anchor: She remembered listening for her mum’s steps every time the front door opened at home

facts.fact: 父亲说不怪你，她回"怪的是你"。
facts.anchor: ‘I want you to know it’s not your fault your mum left.’ Emily stared at him and replied, ‘Of course it’s not, it’s yours.’

facts.fact: JJ 讽 Matty 趁人之危。
facts.anchor: ‘Seriously, mate, you want to try and get into her pants when she’s in this state? Have some self-respect.’

facts.fact: Matty 当面叫出 Liam Craig。
facts.anchor: ‘I called you by your name, Liam Craig. You can stop lying to us now. We both know, Emily and I.’

facts.fact: 她说"我去哪不用你管"，随即后悔——他眼里有绝望。
facts.anchor: ‘I’ll go where I want,’ she said, forgetting that where she wanted to go was not out with JJ at all. She immediately regretted her words. There was something desperate in his eyes.
‘Don’t make me have to stop you.’
